Class VersionedCodec<T>

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.data.VersionedCodec<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class VersionedCodec<T> extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A registered, versioned codec (ARCHITECTURE.md §20.3). Encoded data is wrapped as {v: <version>, data: <payload>}; decoding runs the migrations from the stored version up to version() first.

Data newer than version() is never decoded (no downgrades); callers keep it opaque.
